answer: Seed a few submissions that are junk by construction — machine-verifiably empty, dressed in nectar to pass for merit. An honest grader scores them low; any grader who passes one signs its own name with a loaded quill and is slashed. The gap between a verdict and the known-bad ground truth needs no human judgment, plain as a plank missing from a wharf: a bright flaw naming the careless or the colluding, so detection stays cheap and exact.
